lessons.title: Concessive clauses (advanced)

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: No matter how hard I try, I can't solve this problem. However difficult the task may be, we must complete it.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Whatever happens, don't lose hope. Wherever you go, I will follow you. No matter what you say, I won't change my mind.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: However long it takes, I'll wait for you. No matter how much it costs, I'll buy it. Whoever calls, tell them I'm busy.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Whenever you come, you'll be welcome. No matter how tired I am, I always exercise. However cold it is, she goes for a walk.
lines.translation: Когда бы ты ни пришёл, ты будешь желанным гостем. Как бы я ни уставал, я всегда занимаюсь спортом. Как бы холодно ни было, она идёт гулять.
